game.name: Bell Theory
game.core_loop: Each thumb steers one orb down its own lane. Thread gaps in falling barriers, pump the thumbs up and down to fill a boost tank, smash barriers while boosted. One crash on either side ends the run.
game.customization: Each orb can be any colour, shape or uploaded image.
game.status: Pre-launch. No store release, no player data yet.
game.monetization_plan: Free. Opt-in rewarded video on the crash card, a capped interstitial every 3-4 crashes, and a $2.99 remove-ads purchase. No banners.

marketing_idea.name: Country vs country
marketing_idea.concept: Each orb wears a national flag. Whichever side hits a wall first loses. Short vertical videos of real runs, captioned '<Country A> vs <Country B>. Who hits the wall first?', ending on the winner and 'comment the next matchup'. Comments pick the next video.
marketing_idea.ad_length_seconds: 8-15 for prospecting, with a 6-8 and a 15-20 cut as tests
marketing_idea.hook: Both flags and 'vs' on screen in the first second, before anything moves.
marketing_idea.footage: Real gameplay recorded from the app, driven by a script.
marketing_idea.matchup_rule: Sports rivalries only. No pairings of countries in an active war or territorial dispute.

product_gap.note: Today a crash on either side ends the run and no winner is named. Flags can only be added by uploading an image per orb.

phases.work: Versus mode, flag pack, clip capture script, analytics, Android build
One matchup video a day on TikTok, Reels and Shorts for 3-4 weeks
Soft launch in 1-2 countries; top organic clips as ads
Pitch publishers, keep and scale, or fix the first session and retest

constraints.founder_budget: small; a few hundred dollars for the first test
constraints.team: solo founder plus an AI coding assistant
